patterns.note: Extreme vertical whitespace separates key feature blocks, forcing absolute focus on one isolated card or value proposition at a time.
A high-saturation royal blue is used exclusively for primary CTAs and the hero mockup background, creating an instant visual anchor against an otherwise muted canvas.
Low-contrast, muted gray body text contrasts with bold, pitch-black headings to establish a quiet, premium editorial hierarchy.
Smooth scroll-driven momentum paired with an autoplaying, looping video mockup in the hero that demonstrates real-time app interactions.

technique_notes: To recreate this ultra-clean aesthetic, implement a smooth-scroll wrapper (like Locomotive Scroll) to control scroll momentum and soften transitions. Use massive viewport-height-based vertical padding to isolate content blocks. The hero features a high-fidelity phone mockup overlaying a vibrant blue container, containing an autoplaying, looping inline video of the app's UI. Text elements use subtle scroll-triggered opacity fades to ease into view as the user scrolls down.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clean, geometric sans-serif with bold, medium-large headings (~3x body size) and highly muted, regular-weight body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded: mockups and container cards use a generous, smooth corner radius matching iOS app design standards.
design_tokens.spacing: Extremely airy, utilizing vast empty vertical space to create a calm, distraction-free reading flow.

standout: The site stands out through its radical commitment to whitespace and minimalism, treating each feature as a single, isolated gallery piece. The vibrant royal blue hero block instantly commands attention against an otherwise whisper-quiet, off-white canvas.
